name: fz-compact
description: Local masking compaction for background sessions: after the prompt cache goes cold, large old tool results move to local files and are replaced by short placeholders. No model calls. Off until enabled.

enabled.title: Enable fz-compact
enabled.description: Turns the plugin on. Off, or with any setting out of its range, it starts no timer, queues no /compact and appends no guidance.

idleGuardMinutes.title: Idle minutes before masking
idleGuardMinutes.description: Minutes a background session must stay idle before its old tool results are masked; by default just past the one-hour prompt cache. A number of at least 1.

idleMinTokens.title: Minimum context tokens
idleMinTokens.description: Idle masking is queued, and a resume masks results not masked before, only when the context holds at least this many tokens; a resume whose session reports no size counts the conversation's characters at four a token. A number of at least 1.

keepRecentUserTurns.title: Recent prompts kept
keepRecentUserTurns.description: Tool results at or after the oldest of this many latest prompts you sent are never masked; background task notifications and local command output do not count. A whole number of at least 1.

minMaskChars.title: Minimum result size
minMaskChars.description: Tool results shorter than this many characters are kept. A whole number of at least 1.

minNetReductionPercent.title: Minimum saving (percent)
minNetReductionPercent.description: A masking that would save less than this percent of the conversation's characters (message text, tool-call arguments and tool results) is skipped. A number from 0 to 100.

minNetReductionTokens.title: Minimum saving (tokens)
minNetReductionTokens.description: A masking that would save fewer than this many tokens (four characters each) is skipped. A number of at least 0.

remaskOnResume.title: Mask again on resume
remaskOnResume.description: When a background session resumes, mask again the results masked before it stopped, or mask anew after a long idle.

spillDir.title: Spill folder
spillDir.description: Absolute folder that keeps the original tool results; a relative path or / alone is refused and turns the plugin off. Empty: ~/.claude/fz-compact/spill. Reads of the spill files fz-compact recorded there are allowed without asking, so use a folder kept for this alone.

spillRetentionDays.title: Spill retention (days)
spillRetentionDays.description: Spill files older than this many days are removed at session start. A number of at least 1.
